claims.statement: FDA HACCP guidance places microbiological testing within a broader system of preventive controls, verification, corrective action, and records.
FDA guidance supports maintaining control while testing and generally does not treat later negative samples as invalidating a confirmed positive.
FDA BAM publishes preferred microbiological laboratory procedures; this recipe does not claim to implement them.
SP-204 and its entire decision setting are fictional.
The initial screen and all current-state probabilities were fabricated; the prior is supplied after that fictional result.
All utilities are fabricated dimensionless preference points, not illness estimates, money, or regulatory thresholds.
All likelihoods and costs were fabricated and are not test performance, a validated sampling plan, or regulatory guidance.

appliesTo: gross and net value of information
claims.statement: Numerical results are deterministic consequences of the synthetic fixture under finite_information_acquisition@1.
